name: Sustain rapport across repeated meetings
short_description: Sustain rapport across repeated meetings once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can sustain rapport across repeated meetings in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Sustain rapport across repeated meetings means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Sustain rapport across repeated meetings in a fresh real-life scenario.
